page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; small marginal notes in the left margin beside lines 6, 11, 15, 16 and 22; running head with page number at the top; nothing below the text except small marks at the bottom left.

main_text.p: nus docet, locum in urbe peramplum fuisse moenibus contiguum, cui nomen Megara, & eum, occupatâ prius privati hominis turri sitâ extra moenia iisdem moenibus proximâ, & paris cum moe-nibus altitudinis, ex eadem illa turri per noctem oppugnatum & captum esse à Scipione, atque istuc ipsum, dif-fractâ per audaces juvenes, qui primi ex moenibus in Megara desilierant, portâ, cum militibus quater mille ingressum, ac in tantum terrorem tum Carthagi-nienses dedisse, ut hi quasi reliqua urbe captâ in Byrsam arcem confugerint: verum Scipionem, propterea quòd Me-gara hortis & stirpibus aestivorum fru-ctuum feracibus plena essent, & mace-riis vivisque sepibus ac aliis sentibus di-stincta,& rivi profundi ac flexuosi com-plures quoque locum permearent, insi-dias nocturnas tali loco veritum, si sui hostem perfequerentur, pedem inde tunc retulisse. Dein paulo post Appia-nus hæc addit: Scipio toto Isthmo (intelligit cervicem, quà Carthaginis sedes solum peninsulare continenti collas-[?]rebat) potitus fossam à mari ad mare perduxit, ad teli jactum ab hostibus fe-[?]otus. Illi tamen opus impedire conabantur, quod per stadia xxv militibus [illegible, ~2 letters][?]antibus simul & propugnantibus ab-solutum

page.notes: Head running title and page number read as printed. Left margin marks beside lines 6, 11, 15, 16 and 22 are small symbols and sigla I could not read; they are noted only where they stand. Bottom left shows "DG" and "D" in small type; I could not tell whether these are a signature or margin marks, so I did not transcribe them as signature. Doubtful words: "collas-rebat" (x/s uncertain), "fe-otus" (second half of the line-end word unclear), "[?]antibus" (the first letters are obscured by the margin mark). The text ends mid-sentence with "solutum" on the last line, which is a continuation onto the next page. The first paragraph is marked cont="true" because the text starts with the fragment "nus".
